description: Article import command: one transaction and one try/except wrap the whole loop, so the first bad row rolls back every imported article while the command still reports success.
notes: FM-01 (partial failure in batches). handle() wraps the whole loop in a single transaction.atomic() inside a single try/except. The first row with an unknown author or a missing field raises, which rolls back every article imported so far and skips all the rows after it, yet the command logs one warning, prints `Imported N articles.` (counting the rolled-back rows) and exits 0. Severity important: FM-01 is important when good items are lost; it's an operator-run command, not a live pipeline, so not critical. Fix: per-row handling (a savepoint or try/except per row, record the skipped rows) and report imported and skipped counts from what was committed. Argument parsing, loading and the README are legitimate.
